title: crataegus × macrocarpa subsp. calciphila
intro: Crataegus × macrocarpa subsp. calciphila, commonly known as the hawthorn, is a hybrid species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae, known for its medicinal properties. The hawthorn has been used to promote cardiovascular health, reducing the risk of heart failure and high blood pressure, due to its ability to lower cholesterol levels and improve blood vessel function. Its therapeutic actions include vasodilation, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of hawthorn include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
